definitions.explanation: A person who holds a higher position in an organization's hierarchy. Refers to someone above you in rank at work, in the military, or in other structured organizations.

examples.japanese: {上役|うわやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧。
{上役|うわやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{進|すす}められない→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: We cannot proceed without the approval of our superiors.

examples.japanese: {上役|うわやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}に{入|い}られる→気に入る：02047_kiniiru⟧こと⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: He only thinks about getting in his superiors' good graces.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{上役|うわやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The new boss listens well to subordinates' opinions.

notes:
A slightly old-fashioned but still commonly understood word for workplace superiors. Compound of 上 (above) + 役 (role/position). Has a somewhat impersonal, institutional feel — it refers to the position rather than the personal relationship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上役|うわやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧: to report to one's superiors
- {上役|うわやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧: orders from above
- {上役|うわやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔色|かおいろ}をうかがう→顔色をうかがう：08973_kaoirowoukagau⟧: to read one's superiors' mood
- {上役|うわやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逆|さか}らう→逆らう：02106_sakarau⟧: to go against one's superiors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧: boss, superior — the most common modern term in business
- ⟦{目上|めうえ}→目上：03804_meue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: one's senior/superior — broader; includes age-based hierarchy
- ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧: senior — based on experience/tenure rather than formal rank
